summary: Iteration 3 — Faculty/Reviews layer. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass, including rubric public endpoint, faculty auth gate (student→403 / faculty→200 on dashboard, project view, create review), assignment guard, dashboard tiles (6 projects with Neon Heart at status=revision_requested, review_count=5), full faculty project snapshot, append-only + supersedes guarantee (old rubric row remains and gets superseded_by set to new id), validation errors (rubric missing scores→400, invalid status_value→400, time_coded missing timestamp→400), /projects/{id}/reviews visibility for student owner and assigned faculty (author name attached), and /student/reviews-summary returning 6 projects with reviews[<=12]. Frontend: faculty login shows Faculty sidebar group + nav-faculty-dashboard link, /faculty renders 4 stat cards + 6 project cards, Neon Heart detail page shows 'Revision requested' status pill and all 7 tabs (keys: reviews/treatment/storyboard/shots/rough_cut/rights/budget). Written note, rubric (all 6 competencies at 4→save), coverage response, status change (accept dialog), and time-coded note composers all post successfully and append to the immutable history (review count grew 10→14, 'Superseded' markers appeared on previous rubric row). Student login: no faculty nav link, /reviews shows timeline with 20 events on Neon Heart, /faculty renders inline 'faculty-only' notice with no crash.

issues: Time-coded composer button label reads 'POST AT 0:00' after the playhead range input is scrubbed programmatically — the React state binding on faculty-rough-cut-playhead only updates on the native 'input'/'change' event fired by a real drag, so posting still uses 0s. Real user drag likely works, but the seeded 0:42 note remains visible and the new note lands at 0:00 in the automated flow. Minor testability quibble, not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1489 lines — consider splitting the Faculty/Reviews section into a routers/faculty.py module (already >700 line threshold).

_record_review lets `supersedes` be set for kinds other than status/rubric with no validation — a client could supersede a written note with a coverage_response. Consider validating kind-compatibility, and 404-ing when supersedes id does not exist in this project (currently silently no-ops the update).
faculty_dashboard runs one DB round-trip per assigned project to fetch reviews; fine for 6 projects but should use a single aggregate + $group when assignments scale.

REVIEW_STATUSES is defined but not exported via any endpoint; the frontend hard-codes ['open','revision_requested','approved','final'] — consider exposing it alongside /rubric/competencies for a single source of truth.
seed_data_creation: None — relied on _ensure_faculty_reviews_seed which is idempotent. Test run inserted 5+ new append-only rows on Neon Heart (TEST_ prefixed messages) — safe because the ledger is meant to be immutable and additive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Faculty/Reviews (iter 3) is fully green. Note that test_faculty_reviews.py POSTs immutable review rows every run — this is by design (append-only ledger) but the review_count on Neon Heart will grow over repeated runs. Assertions use >=5 to remain stable. The one non-blocker to be aware of: automating the rough-cut playhead via el.value + dispatchEvent does NOT update React state on the current implementation; a real drag works but Playwright-based checks should either fire pointer events or set the range via keyboard.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — all requested behaviors verified.
